window_boundary_method: Frozen pre-change chroma components with height >= 20% and area >= 0.5% of frame; exactly three main windows, plus two side windows in wide views. Include frozen isolated baseline chroma pixels within 3px of those windows when every RGB channel is below 80; these are pre-existing antialias fringe. Header/console envelopes use first/last window pixel per column, interpolated across opaque struts and side walls. All sky outside the frozen components is also counted. One-pixel dilation is diagnostic only, never the pass criterion.

rendered_rgb_16x9.comparison: Exact saved RGB bytes, without tolerance or denoising exclusions.
rendered_rgb_16x9.allowed_change_rule: Previously pure backdrop above header/below console becomes hardware; baseline mask alpha = 0, new alpha > 0.
rendered_rgb_16x9.comparison_scope: Historical gap-closure reference; finish 4 intentionally changes hardware colours.
